GDPR.question: Does this passage address {name} ({definition})? Answer with one option only.

requirements.name: the identity of the controller
requirements.definition: who the controller is: the name of the company, developer or person responsible for processing the personal data, or of their representative

requirements.name: the data protection officer
requirements.definition: the contact details of the data protection officer

requirements.name: the purposes of processing
requirements.definition: what the personal data are processed or used for

requirements.name: the right of access
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to request access to their personal data

requirements.name: the right to rectification
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to request the correction of their personal data

requirements.name: the right to data portability
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to receive their personal data or have them transmitted to another provider

requirements.name: the right to withdraw consent
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to withdraw their consent at any time

requirements.name: the recipients of the data
requirements.definition: whether and with which third parties, or categories of third parties, the personal data are shared

requirements.name: the source of the data
requirements.definition: where the personal data come from, for example directly from the user, from third parties or from public sources

requirements.name: the contact details of the controller
requirements.name_of: the contact details of the controller
requirements.definition: how to contact the controller or their representative, for example an e-mail or postal address

requirements.name: the categories of personal data
requirements.definition: which kinds of personal data are processed

requirements.name: the legal basis for processing
requirements.definition: the legal ground on which the personal data are processed, for example consent or legitimate interests

requirements.name: the legitimate interests pursued
requirements.definition: the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or a third party when processing is based on legitimate interests

requirements.name: the storage period
requirements.definition: how long the personal data are kept, or the criteria used to determine that period

requirements.name: transfers to third countries
requirements.definition: whether the personal data are transferred to a third country or international organisation, and the safeguards used

requirements.name: whether providing the data is mandatory
requirements.name_of: whether providing the data is mandatory
requirements.definition: whether providing personal data is a statutory or contractual requirement, whether the data subject is obliged to provide them, and the consequences of not providing them

requirements.name: automated decision-making
requirements.definition: the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, and information about its logic and consequences

requirements.name: the right to erasure
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to request the deletion of their personal data

requirements.name: the right to restriction of processing
requirements.name_of: the right to restriction of processing
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to request that the processing of their personal data be restricted

requirements.name: the right to object
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to object to the processing of their personal data

requirements.name: the right to lodge a complaint
requirements.name_of: the right to lodge a complaint
requirements.definition: the data subject's right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

LGPD.question: Este trecho trata {name} ({definition})? Responda só com uma opção.

requirements.name: the identity of the controller
requirements.definition: quem é o controlador: o nome da empresa ou pessoa responsável pelo tratamento dos dados pessoais

requirements.name: the data protection officer
requirements.definition: a identidade ou as informações de contato do encarregado pelo tratamento de dados pessoais (DPO)

requirements.name: the purposes of processing
requirements.definition: para que os dados pessoais são tratados ou usados

requirements.name: the right of access
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de acessar os seus dados pessoais

requirements.name: the right to rectification
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de pedir a correção de dados incompletos, inexatos ou desatualizados

requirements.name: the right to data portability
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de pedir a portabilidade dos seus dados a outro fornecedor de serviço ou produto

requirements.name: the right to withdraw consent
requirements.name_of: do direito de revogar o consentimento
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de revogar o consentimento a qualquer momento

requirements.name: the recipients of the data
requirements.definition: se e com quais terceiros, ou categorias de terceiros, os dados pessoais são compartilhados

requirements.name: the source of the data
cites: LGPD art. 19, II (origem dos dados; o guia não cita artigo)
requirements.definition: de onde vêm os dados pessoais obtidos indiretamente pelo controlador ou operador

requirements.name: the right to confirm that processing exists
requirements.name_of: do direito de confirmar a existência de tratamento
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de confirmar se os seus dados pessoais são tratados

requirements.name: express consent
requirements.definition: o consentimento do titular dado por escrito

requirements.name: the form and duration of processing
requirements.name_of: da forma e a duração do tratamento
requirements.definition: como e por quanto tempo os dados pessoais são tratados ou guardados

requirements.name: the categories of data processed
requirements.definition: que tipos de dados pessoais são coletados e tratados (por exemplo, localização ou consumo)

requirements.name: the right to anonymization, blocking or deletion
requirements.name_of: do direito à anonimização, bloqueio ou eliminação
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de pedir a anonimização, o bloqueio ou a eliminação de dados desnecessários, excessivos ou tratados em desconformidade com a LGPD

requirements.name: the right to deletion
requirements.definition: o direito do titular de pedir a eliminação dos dados tratados com base no consentimento

requirements.name: the option not to consent
requirements.definition: a possibilidade de o titular não dar o consentimento e as consequências da negativa

requirements.name: automated decisions
requirements.definition: como são tomadas decisões automatizadas e o direito de pedir a revisão delas

CCPA.question: Does this passage address {name} ({definition})? Answer with one option only.

requirements.name: the right to know
cites: Cal. Civ. Code §1798.130(a)(5)(A) (description of the rights under §§1798.110 and 1798.115)
requirements.definition: the consumer's right to know or access the personal information the business has collected about them, or which personal information it has sold or shared and to whom

requirements.name: the right to correct
requirements.definition: the consumer's right to request the correction of inaccurate personal information

requirements.name: the disclosure of personal information to third parties
requirements.name_of: the disclosure of personal information to third parties
requirements.definition: whether and which categories of personal information are disclosed or shared with third parties, service providers or contractors, and with which categories of recipients

requirements.name: the right to delete
requirements.definition: the consumer's right to request the deletion of personal information the business has collected from them

requirements.name: the categories of personal information collected
requirements.name_of: the categories of personal information collected
requirements.definition: which categories of personal information the business collects about consumers

requirements.name: how to exercise privacy rights
cites: Cal. Civ. Code §1798.130(a)(1)(A) and (a)(5)(A) ('two or more designated methods for submitting requests')
requirements.definition: the methods by which consumers can submit requests to exercise their privacy rights, such as a toll-free number, an email address or a web form

requirements.name: the sale of personal information
requirements.definition: whether and which categories of personal information the business sells or shares for cross-context behavioral advertising

requirements.name: the right to opt out of sale
requirements.name_of: the right to opt out of sale
requirements.definition: the consumer's right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information

requirements.name: the right to limit the use of sensitive personal information
requirements.name_of: the right to limit the use of sensitive personal information
requirements.definition: the consumer's right to limit the use and disclosure of their sensitive personal information

requirements.name: the right to non-discrimination
requirements.definition: the consumer's right not to be discriminated or retaliated against for exercising their privacy rights

requirements.name: the date of the last update
cites: Cal. Civ. Code §1798.130(a)(5) ('update that information at least once every 12 months')
requirements.name_of: the date of the last update
requirements.definition: when the privacy policy was last updated or how it is updated
